final_answer.key_evidence_summary: frontend error logs (126/969): 'failed to get ads: rpc error: code = Unavailable ... dial tcp 10.68.76.205:9555: connect: connection refused'. GetResources(services, adservice) shows the adservice Service exists (ClusterIP 10.68.76.205, 9555/TCP) so this is not DNS; GetResources(endpoints, adservice) returns ENDPOINTS <none>. The pods listing has no pod for app=adservice while all 10 other services are 1/1 Running; deployment adservice is 0/1 with UP-TO-DATE 0 and AVAILABLE 0, meaning pods were never created (not scheduling/startup). Namespace events bind the mechanism verbatim: 'Warning FailedCreate replicaset/adservice-6f86c56644 - Error creating: pods "adservice-6f86c56644-" is forbidden: error looking up service account boutique/services: serviceaccount "services" not found'. Config closure: GetAppYAML(adservice) pod template declares serviceAccountName: services, while GetResources(serviceaccounts, namespace=boutique) lists only adservice, default and the other services' accounts - no 'services' ServiceAccount exists, so admission rejects pod creation and the Service keeps zero endpoints.

3. **Take the branch your evidence lands on:**
   - **Pending**: the pod's own sheet first (it carries the scheduling line), then the node side, general before specific; no scheduling line at all → the control-plane scheduler.
   - **Never created / missing reference**: the victim's signal first; then the workload state; then the event names the missing object; read the template and the object's own listing. 4. **When the chain crosses services**, call `GetServiceDependencies` from the symptom side before any mechanism/config/code material; an anchor elsewhere is a guess.
5. **Close with all three:** the mechanism event; the events surface; the config the mechanism points at.

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: adservice
  namespace: boutique 
  labels:
    app: adservice
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: adservice
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: adservice
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: services
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 5
      securityContext:
        fsGroup: 1000
        runAsGroup: 1000
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1000
      containers:
      - name: server
        securityContext:
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          capabilities:
            drop:
              - ALL
          privileged: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
        image: us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/google-samples/microservices-demo/adservice:v0.10.3
        ports:
        - containerPort: 9555
        env:
        - name: PORT
          value: "9555"
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 200m
            memory: 180Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 300m
            memory: 300Mi
        readinessProbe:
          initialDelaySeconds: 5
          grpc:
            port: 9555
        livenessProbe:
          initialDelaySeconds: 5
          grpc:
            port: 9555
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: adservice
  namespace: boutique
  labels:
    app: adservice
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  selector:
    app: adservice
  ports:
  - name: grpc
    port: 9555
    targetPort: 9555
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: adservice
  namespace: boutique
